messages:
Priya: RFC follow-up: staged key-rotation tokens for on-prem/offline bundles. Problem: rotating operator seats in air-gapped clusters requires cumbersome manual signature exchange. Proposal: include time-locked rotation tokens in the bundle that can be activated locally with operator signatures.
Marco: quick question: tokens in bundle sound risky if leaked. How do we prevent replay?
Priya: tokens are single-use, bound to bundle manifest digest, and encrypted with per-cluster seal. Activation requires N-of-M operator signatures plus matching local cluster ID. Replay impossible since token includes nonce and manifest digest.
Lena: UX: operator runs `bundle rotate-prepare` -> signs token(s) offline -> `bundle rotate-commit` applies new seat set. CLI is bundle-local, no network.
Marco: what about emergency rollback? If rotation goes wrong, can we revert?
Priya: yes: keep last-good seats snapshot in local protected store for RETENTION_DAYS (default 14). CLI supports `rotate-rollback --restore-id`. Hard delete only after retention window.
Lena: auditing: every rotate-prep/commit/rollback writes an append-only audit line with signer IDs, timestamp, bundle fingerprint. Local-only by default; hosted installs may export if opted in.
Marco: threat model note: operator key compromise. Mitigation: require at least 2 operator seats for rotation by default, and require out-of-band emergency token for single-seat sites. Also rate-limit rotations (e.g., max 1/day) to avoid automated abuse.
Priya: tests: unit tests for token encoding/verification, e2e in offline k8s cluster, and chaos test simulating partial commit. Action items: Lena docs + CLI spec, Marco threat-model doc, Priya implement token codec + unit tests.
OpsBot: rollout: rfc/staged-rotation v1 canary -> onprem-canary-2 started :rocket:
